none: PAS KENT-FEB93B: Roman copper alloy coin, Radiate of Tetricus I(271-274)
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Roman coin, Radiate of Tetricus I (AD 271-274), Reece period 13 (AD 260-275). The coin is very worn and chipped, both the obverse and reverse are mainly illegible. Obverse: illegible. Legend: [___]. Reverse: might be bases of two standards and a figure in between. Legend: FIDES MILITVM (possibly). Measurments - Weight: 0.84g, diameter: 15.96mm, thickness: 1.28mm
